headline: Keep persona text readable in light theme and clear on mobile

items.title: Keep persona text readable in light theme and clear on mobile
items.insight: Fresh persona screenshots show weak light-theme copy and mobile disclosure text beneath Spark. The existing copy token and text-clearance mechanism provide a focused repair. New captures must prove the reading outcome before release.
items.evidence: Relevant light persona copy meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 against actual rendered panels; all seven persona colors checked. Spark yields around the actual role=note disclosure in both corners, preserves header recall and preferences. Prior clearance/reference tests pass. Fresh desktop/mobile pixels across all themes are inspected with a hash-bound receipt; Juno numeral observation is resolved with actual rendered evidence.
